about_short_description.short_description: Factored Quality is a quality control platform for e-commerce and consumer goods brands.

product.name: Factored Quality Platform
product.description: A unified digital platform to manage quality control, supplier audits, and product compliance for consumer goods brands.

product.name: Quality Control Services
product.description: Services including inspections, audits, and testing throughout the product lifecycle to verify product quality and supplier compliance.

product.name: Supplier Audits
product.description: Audits assessing factory conditions, social and ethical compliance, and environmental impact of suppliers.

product.name: Product Compliance Testing
product.description: Testing services to verify product adherence to regulatory and industry standards across safety, performance, and reliability.

product.name: API Integration
product.description: An API enabling brands to access and integrate quality control data from the Factored Quality platform into their own systems.

product.name: Compliance Gap Analysis
product.description: An AI-driven analysis service that identifies product compliance testing requirements based on product details and target markets.
